verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing/entitlements layer built on top of Stripe (per autumn-comm-4), but no evidence in the pack shows Autumn configuring or exposing digital wallets, local payment methods, bank redirects, or BNPL options as part of its integration surface. The docs focus on metering, feature-gating, plans/pricing, and CLI/API management, with no mention of payment-method configuration for checkout.
